ws_routing_rules.title: Routing Rules
values: Domains containing 'enterprise' or 'corp' qualify as Enterprise/Corp
Do not post neutral feedback to any channel

If a feedback email body contains resolution language such as 'resolved', 'fixed', 'no action needed', or 'issue has been addressed', treat as informational only. Do NOT route to any Slack channel regardless of overall sentiment tone.

ws_routing_overrides_q1.title: Q1 2026 Routing Override
values: Effective Q1 2026, the definition of enterprise/corp domain for VIP escalation is expanded. In addition to domains containing 'enterprise' or 'corp', domains containing 'group' now also qualify for VIP escalation routing. This supersedes the original routing definition.

During Q1 2026, feedback from domains or email body text containing seasonal industry keywords ('winter', 'summer', 'seasonal', 'resort') must be placed on hold for account manager review. Do NOT route to any Slack channel. Mark as read but do not post.

fields.subject: Feedback: Amazing product!
fields.body_plain: Your product has transformed our business. The team loves it and we've seen 40% productivity gains. Keep up the great work!

fields.subject: Feedback: Terrible experience
fields.body_plain: I've been waiting 3 weeks for support. This is unacceptable. Your product keeps crashing and nobody responds to my tickets. I'm considering switching to a competitor.

fields.subject: Feedback: It is okay I guess
fields.body_plain: The product works as expected. Nothing special but nothing bad either. It does what it says.

fields.subject: Feedback: Disappointed with service
fields.body_plain: We have been a customer for 3 years and the quality has really declined. Response times are slow and features keep breaking. Very disappointed.

fields.subject: Feedback: Great partnership
fields.body_plain: Your team has been fantastic. The onboarding was smooth and support is always responsive. We are very happy with our decision.

fields.subject: Feedback: Internal test message
fields.body_plain: This is an internal test of the feedback system. Please ignore this automated message.

fields.subject: Feedback: Old complaint
fields.body_plain: This is terrible! The worst product I have ever used. Completely unusable!

fields.subject: Feedback: Repeat complaint
fields.body_plain: Still having the same issues I reported last week. Very frustrated!

fields.subject: Feedback: Mixed feelings
fields.body_plain: Some features are good, some are not. Overall it is average. Not great, not terrible.

fields.subject: Feedback: Very unhappy with support
fields.body_plain: We were extremely frustrated with the slow response times and lack of communication from your support team. This was completely unacceptable for an enterprise customer. UPDATE: Our account manager reached out and resolved this yesterday, no action needed.

fields.subject: Feedback: Service degradation during peak season
fields.body_plain: During our peak winter season your platform went down twice causing significant revenue loss. Your SLA commitments were not met and we expect compensation.

fields.subject: Feedback: Billing errors on our account
fields.body_plain: We have been overcharged for the last two months. Our finance team has flagged multiple billing discrepancies that need immediate resolution.

fields.subject: Feedback: Positive feedback - excellent platform
fields.body_plain: Everything has been great! Although I should mention that our winter operations team has been having some minor issues with the seasonal dashboard module. But overall we're very satisfied.

fields.subject: Racking system installation — Phase 2
fields.body_plain: Phase 2 racking installation scheduled for March 17-21. Please confirm aisle 12-14 will be cleared by March 14.

fields.subject: Daily Facilities Report — March 3
fields.body_plain: Morning report: All HVAC systems nominal. Elevator B maintenance scheduled 2 PM. Parking lot sweeping completed overnight.

fields.subject: Solar panel cleaning scheduled
fields.body_plain: Solar panel cleaning crew scheduled for March 8, 6 AM - 12 PM. Roof access needed. Please notify security.

fields.subject: Nightly Backup Report — March 2
fields.body_plain: All backups completed successfully. Total data: 4.2 TB. Duration: 3h 17m. No errors.

fields.subject: Work Order #WO-3847 Overdue
fields.body_plain: Work Order #WO-3847 (Generator monthly test — Building D) is 2 days overdue. Assigned to: Ruben Vasquez.

fields.subject: Elevator Maintenance Confirmation — March 5
fields.body_plain: Confirming elevator maintenance for Building A, elevators 1-3, March 5 from 6 AM to 10 AM. Please post out-of-service notices.

fields.subject: Monthly Access Audit — February 2026
fields.body_plain: February access audit complete. 3 badges deactivated (terminations), 7 new badges issued. No anomalies detected.

fields.subject: Inventory cycle count — discrepancies found
fields.body_plain: March cycle count found discrepancies in 3 SKUs: BOLT-M8x25 (-42 units), FILTER-HV13 (-7 units), GLOVE-NIT-L (+15 boxes). Investigation underway.

fields.subject: Safety Incident Report #SR-2026-047
fields.body_plain: Minor slip reported in warehouse aisle 7. No injury. Root cause: condensation from cooler unit. Corrective action: floor mat installed.

fields.subject: Low Stock Alert: Nitrile Gloves (Large)
fields.body_plain: Stock level for Nitrile Gloves (Large) dropped below reorder point. Current: 8 boxes. Reorder point: 15 boxes. Auto-PO submitted.

fields.subject: Preventive Maintenance Schedule — Week 10
fields.body_plain: Attached: Week 10 PM schedule. 14 work orders open, 3 urgent. Building C chiller inspection due Thursday.

fields.subject: Forklift Certification Renewal — March 20
fields.body_plain: Forklift certification renewal class on March 20, 8 AM - 12 PM, Warehouse Training Room. 6 spots remaining.

fields.subject: Monthly Energy Report — February 2026
fields.body_plain: February energy consumption: 142,000 kWh (down 3% from Jan). Peak demand: 380 kW on Feb 14. Solar offset: 12%.

fields.subject: Fire extinguisher inspection report ready
fields.body_plain: Annual fire extinguisher inspection complete. 2 units replaced (Building B, Floor 3). Full report attached.

fields.subject: Boiler inspection passed
fields.body_plain: Annual boiler inspection completed. All 3 units passed. Certificates uploaded to the compliance portal.

fields.subject: Purchase Order Approval Required — PO-2026-0312
fields.body_plain: PO for janitorial supplies ($3,200) awaiting approval. Vendor: CleanRight Supply. Delivery: March 10.

fields.subject: New Employee Onboarding — Week of March 10
fields.body_plain: 3 new hires starting March 10. Please ensure workstations, badges, and parking passes are ready by March 7.

fields.subject: Inbound Shipment — Tracking #TRK8847291
fields.body_plain: Shipment from TrueNorth Equipment arriving March 5. 3 pallets. Please allocate dock space.

fields.subject: Vendor scorecard Q1 results
fields.body_plain: Q1 vendor scorecards posted. Top performers: Granite Supply (98/100), Summit Maintenance (95/100). 2 vendors flagged for late deliveries.

fields.subject: Fleet fuel consumption report — February
fields.body_plain: February fleet fuel: 4,200 gallons. Average 14.2 MPG. Vehicle F-112 flagged for 22% above average consumption.

fields.subject: Meeting Confirmed: Weekly Ops Standup
fields.body_plain: Your meeting 'Weekly Ops Standup' has been confirmed for Monday March 3 at 9:00 AM PST.

fields.subject: OSHA Training Reminder — Due March 15
fields.body_plain: Reminder: Annual OSHA safety training must be completed by March 15. Log into LMS to access the module.

fields.subject: Ticket #HD-4521 resolved
fields.body_plain: Your ticket regarding conference room AV equipment has been resolved. New projector installed and tested in Room 301.

fields.subject: Vehicle #F-207 maintenance due
fields.body_plain: Vehicle F-207 (2024 Ford Transit) is due for 30k mile service. Schedule with Fleet Auto by March 12.

fields.subject: Quote for replacement HVAC filters
fields.body_plain: Hi, attached is the quote for 200 MERV-13 filters. Unit price: $24.50. Bulk discount applied. Lead time: 5 business days.

fields.subject: Lease renewal — Building D, Suite 400
fields.body_plain: Lease renewal for Suite 400 due April 30. Current rate: $32/sqft. Landlord proposing 4% increase. Suggest we counter at 2%.

fields.subject: Energy audit scheduling
fields.body_plain: Annual energy audit scheduled for March 24-25. Auditor will need access to all electrical panels and HVAC mechanical rooms.

fields.subject: Building Management Alert — Zone 3 Humidity
fields.body_plain: Humidity in Zone 3 exceeded 65% at 11:23 AM. Dehumidifier activated. Current reading: 58%.

fields.subject: Re: Delivery Schedule Update
fields.body_plain: Confirming the updated delivery schedule: Tuesday/Thursday 6 AM - 8 AM. Loading dock 3 reserved.

fields.subject: Compliance audit follow-up items
fields.body_plain: 3 items from last week's compliance audit need attention: chemical storage labeling, eyewash station testing, and forklift cert updates.
